scope: Final automated verification of the current shared source after native QA fixes. Native UI outcomes are recorded separately by the native operator.

invokeCapabilityAudit.note: The source inventory includes cfg-gated QA entries. This count is not a claim that QA handlers exist in a normal or release binary.

normalSourceRust.command: env -u LBJ_NATIVE_QA -u VITE_NATIVE_QA -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_URI -u LBJ_PRINTER_MODULE_TEST_PACKAGE cargo test --lib -- --skip real_mariadb_ --skip live_snapshot_is_consistent_and_schema_lock_is_connection_scoped --skip validates_a_package_created_by_the_javascript_packager_when_supplied
normalSourceRust.compilerWarningKind: Existing unused restore helper functions in commerce.rs
normalSourceRust.note: Environment-dependent tests were explicitly filtered rather than allowed to return early and be misreported as executed passes. This run did not use or change the original database.

qaIsolationSourceAudit.buildGate: src-tauri/build.rs emits cfg(native_qa) only when LBJ_NATIVE_QA=1, the native-qa Cargo feature is selected, and PROFILE=debug.
qaIsolationSourceAudit.commandGate: All four native_qa command registrations and the enabled implementation module require cfg(native_qa). The normal checkpoint implementation is a no-op.
qaIsolationSourceAudit.runtimeGate: QA startup and commands require the exact isolated application identifier com.elamreda.tauri-app.native-qa and the compile-time QA opt-in.
qaIsolationSourceAudit.frontendGate: VITE_NATIVE_QA=1 and isTauri() are both required for the QA frontend checkpoint and controls.
qaIsolationSourceAudit.secretIsolation: The isolated identifier skips legacy keychain migration; other secret operations use app-local files. QA provider network calls are rejected and printer/drawer network transport is loopback-only.
qaIsolationSourceAudit.normalBuildResult: Normal-source Rust tests compiled and passed without QA opt-ins; enabled QA tests and command implementations are excluded by cfg.
qaIsolationSourceAudit.releaseBuildResult: Not compiled in this verification. Source gate excludes PROFILE=release even with the QA feature and environment opt-in; no release artifact verification is claimed.

limits: These automated results do not replace the separately recorded native Tauri interactions.
Physical printers, card terminals, external provider services, and live business data were not certified by this run.
The disposable loopback-only MariaDB candidate remains running for the separately controlled native reconnect exercise.
